name: ServiceLevelObjective
description: A service level objective (SLO) that sets a target for a service level indicator (SLI) over a rolling time window, paired with an error budget that tracks remaining tolerance for unreliability.

description.description: Description of what this SLO measures and why it matters.
description.example: Tracks the availability of the checkout API as observed by customers.

service.description: Service or component this SLO applies to.

indicator.description: The service level indicator (SLI) that this SLO targets.

good_query.description: Query or expression that returns the count of good events.

total_query.description: Query or expression that returns the count of total valid events.

target.description: Target ratio for the SLI, expressed as a value between 0 and 1.

window.description: Rolling time window over which the SLO is evaluated.

error_budget.description: Error budget derived from the target and window.

remaining.description: Fraction of error budget remaining in the current window.

burn_rate.description: Current burn rate as a multiple of the sustainable rate.

owner.description: Team or person that owns this SLO.
